simple: F5’s WAF for your own data center and private cloud (formerly BIG-IP Advanced WAF): runs on BIG-IP hardware platforms, as a virtual appliance on common hypervisors, or in AWS, Azure and Google Cloud. Protects websites and APIs (REST/JSON, XML, GraphQL) from OWASP Top 10 and zero-day attacks: it combines signatures, machine learning and behavioral analysis, and builds the policy itself by learning the application. Fends off application-layer DoS (behavioral analytics), stops bots and password guessing, including stuffing of stolen credentials; encrypts entered data right in the browser so malware on the visitor’s computer can’t intercept it (man-in-the-browser). Also protects MCP traffic for AI agents. Accepts results from vulnerability scanners (DAST/SAST) to update protection, sends events to SIEM, SOAR and XDR; configured as code via an API. F5 threat intelligence (IP reputation, active attack campaigns) is a separate subscription.
